g.text: Economics pulls toward one global pool. Politics pulls toward local fleets.
So global. is the cheapest profile
Korea: national AI centre, 15,000 chips by 2028
India: ~34,000 GPUs via IndiaAI · NZ: Kererū.ai
Where new capacity actually gets built
Our read, not a published forecast: regulated industries and government end up in-country; everyone else rides the global pool.
HBM scarcity means the biggest Regions get new capacity first, so smaller countries wait longest.
